title: PTPGE vendor-declaration/1
description: What a printer is and can make, in the vocabulary: identity, production capability, the products it offers. Written by the printer or its MIS and published on the printer's own domain at /.well-known/ptpge/declaration.json (SD-0101). Every vocabulary value is a term URI under https://ptpge.org/v1/ — never a label (SD-0097). Prices and price rules are not part of this document. Licence of the schema: CC BY 4.0.

identity.description: The printer's entry in the Vendors register — the subject of this document.

name.description: Trading name as shown on the register entry.

legalName.description: Registered company name, where it differs from the trading name.

domain.description: The domain this document is published on; the register points at it. Ownership is proven by the file being there.

vendorTypes.description: What kind of vendor; pick all that apply.

languages.description: BCP 47 tags the printer answers requests in.

logo.description: Optional. Shown on the register entry next to the ptpge-id/1 mark.

offerings.description: The products the printer offers, each as a product term plus the subset of its template the printer accepts. May be empty: a declaration without offerings still states identity and capability.

modified.description: When this document was last changed; the register's weekly re-check compares it.

generatedBy.description: Which tool wrote the document. Open: an implementation may add its own fields here (a profile seal, a version) — nothing under generatedBy is read by the register.

termUri.description: A term in the vocabulary. Absolute URI; resolves to JSON-LD.

colorNotation.description: Front/back ink counts, e.g. 4/4, 4/0, 1/1 — resolved against the vocabulary by implementations (ptpge_resolve_color_notation).

equipment.description: A machine. The maker is a supplier in the register; the model is the maker's own designation (models are not terms — SD-0097). A grade of 'catalog-listed' means the model appears in the supplier's catalogue; 'self-declared' means it does not, or the supplier has no catalogue yet.

supplier.description: The maker, as its entry in the Suppliers register.

model.description: The maker's model designation, without the maker's name («Speedmaster XL 106»).

equipmentGrade.description: catalog-listed — the model is in the maker's catalogue; self-declared — named by the printer only.

installedUnits.description: How many of this model the printer runs.

substrate.description: A substrate the line prints on: either a vocabulary term (a class — coated paper, foam board …) or an item in a supplier's catalogue (a series or grade), optionally with the grammages and shades stocked.

item.description: The item's identifier in the supplier's catalogue (supplier-catalogue/1).

class.description: The vocabulary class the item belongs to.

supplier.description: The maker, as its entry in the Suppliers register.

model.description: The maker's model designation, without the maker's name («Speedmaster XL 106»).

kind.description: Equipment class in the vocabulary (folder, cutter, saddle stitcher …).

inline.description: Runs inline with the press (no separate pass).

maxFormatMm.description: Largest sheet the machine takes, width × height in mm.

equipmentGrade.description: catalog-listed — the model is in the maker's catalogue; self-declared — named by the printer only.

installedUnits.description: How many of this model the printer runs.

line.description: A production line: one printing technology, one or more presses, what it prints on and how.

name.description: The printer's own name for the line, as it appears on quotes and job tickets («Sheet-fed Offset 70×100»).

technology.description: The printing technology of the line, as a vocabulary term (offset, UV inkjet, laser, riso …).

presses.description: The presses on the line: each a supplier identity from the register plus the maker's model designation.

inkStations.description: Number of printing units / ink stations on the press (8 = eight colours or 4/4 in one pass).

maxFormatMm.description: Largest sheet the line takes, width × height in mm.

sides.description: simplex — one side per pass; perfecting — both sides in one pass; turn — both sides with a work-and-turn.

substrates.description: What the line prints on: vocabulary classes (coated paper, foam board …) and/or catalogue items from a supplier's catalogue, with grammages and shades stocked.

substrateWeightGsm.description: The grammage range the line runs, g/m².

colorModes.description: Colour modes the line can print: CMYK, black, spot colour, white, extended gamut … as vocabulary terms.

variableData.description: Whether the line prints variable data (personalised content per copy).

finishing.description: Completions the line offers in-house, as vocabulary terms (folding, saddle stitching, die-cutting …).

embellishment.description: Surface finishes and embellishments offered: laminations, spot UV, foil … as vocabulary terms.

finishingMachines.description: The finishing equipment behind the finishing list: supplier identity, model, and the completions each machine performs.

technologies.description: Every printing technology the printer runs, as vocabulary terms — the union of the lines' technologies.

lines.description: The production lines, one per press or press family (what the Vendor Profile builder calls production lines): technology, presses, what each prints on and how it finishes.

certifications.description: Print standards and certifications held (terms under printing/standards).

offering.description: A product the printer offers: the product term, which line makes it, and — per variable of the product's template — the values the printer accepts. Keys of `supports` are variable URIs the template lists; values are term URIs from the template's envelope. Implementations validate a request against this the same way they validate it against the template.

product.description: The product template offered (a term under ordering/products/).

name.description: The printer's own name for the offering («Business Cards 85×55»).

supports.description: Per variable of the product's template, the values the printer accepts — the template's envelope narrowed to this printer. Keys are variable URIs, values lists of term URIs. A key may carry a part scope, <variable>@<part> (SD-0102, the same notation as the ptpge-cfs/1 fingerprint): the values accepted for that part of the product — substrate-weight@cover and substrate-weight@inside for a booklet whose cover and inside pages are different sheets. Only the substrate variables take a part scope, and the part must be one the product's setup model declares (multi-page: cover, inside). A key without scope covers the whole product; a scoped key, where present, replaces it for that part.

pages.description: Page counts offered, for multi-page products.

customSizeMm.description: For products with free dimensions: the width and height ranges accepted, mm.

minimumQuantity.description: Smallest run the printer takes for this offering.

leadTimeWorkingDays.description: Standard lead time from approved artwork to dispatch, working days.
